PANDA improves the impact of humanitarian and development interventions through programme design, assessments, and monitoring & evaluation. In his/her mission, the Country Representative will be hosted by Acted and will fall under the direct responsibility and management of Acted’s Country Director for all Administrative, Security, Logistics and Finance issues.
